findings.title: Saudi-backed forces launch a major attack on Houthi rebels in Yemen, and other Mideast news (section: Israel rejects request to release Palestinian doctor)
findings.location: Beersheba court, Israel; detainee formerly directed Kamal Adwan Hospital, northern Gaza
findings.affected_population_or_system: Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, former director of Kamal Adwan Hospital in Gaza, detained since December 2024 without trial or filed criminal charges; continued detention has direct implications for the detained healthcare professional. Reported health deterioration remains an attributed concern, not independently medically verified.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: An Israeli court on Wednesday extended the detention of Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, the former director of Gaza’s Kamal Adwan Hospital, by six months.
findings.source_type: Established wire reporting (AP), corroborated by Anadolu Agency report citing Physicians for Human Rights-Israel
findings.confidence: medium-high for reported six-month detention extension and denied release; primary court order not independently inspected

discovery_context.first_seen: Associated Press November 18 rolling regional news article checked during this watch; independent Anadolu-attributed report discovered in targeted detainee search.
discovery_context.novelty: New court order on November 18 extending an existing Gaza hospital director's detention another six months, and rejecting a request for release. The prior hourly heartbeat included no detainee/court update. This is a follow-up change in detention status, not a new arrest.
discovery_context.corroboration: AP directly reports the court order and release refusal. The Anadolu-syndicated November 18 report attributes the same decision to Physicians for Human Rights-Israel, specifying Beersheba and no criminal charges.
discovery_context.limitations: Exact ruling time, case docket, written court order and primary PHRI statement were not directly obtained. AP rolling article does not supply a reliable precise Gaza-section insertion time. Court justification and contested underlying allegations are not treated as proven.

limitations: WHO Eastern Mediterranean returned persistent HTTP 502. WHO Global and OCHA OPT remained accessible. Watch status DEGRADED due to ongoing regional source-access limitation; no new material watch-system failure.

coverage_notes.overall: One qualifying new follow-up: the November 18 six-month court extension of Gaza hospital director Hussam Abu Safiya's detention without charge. No other new independently traceable Gaza humanitarian incident established this window. Persistent previously known WHO EMRO access limitation.
